metadata.description: Legal Authority Lab — Florida family law skill suites. Core Foundation ships with every package; each numbered suite is a separately purchased plugin.

plugins.name: lal-core-foundation
plugins.description: Core Foundation — Foundation layer every suite depends on: installer, file connector, start-case, command center, brand kit, correspondence, caselaw protocol, help, file organizer, judicial procedures, Florida ethics. Florida family law. Built inside a real, active family law firm.

plugins.name: lal-financial-discovery-core
plugins.description: Financial Discovery — Core — Complete financial discovery pipeline: intake through ED chart, Rule 12.285 compliance, QC gates. Florida family law. Built inside a real, active family law firm.

plugins.name: lal-financial-discovery-advanced
plugins.description: Financial Discovery — Advanced — Advanced income analysis and contested discovery: interrogatories, RFPs, RFAs, subpoenas, motions to compel, CS worksheet. Florida family law. Built inside a real, active family law firm.

plugins.name: lal-mediation-advocate
plugins.description: Mediation & Settlement — Advocate — Advocate-side mediation: prep engine (ED chart, scenarios, proposals, mediator summary), live session command center, MSA drafting, parenting plan. Florida family law. Built inside a real, active family law firm.

plugins.name: lal-drafting-core
plugins.description: Drafting — Core — Notices, basic motions, ancillary proposed orders, responses, pre-filing compliance checks, AI disclosure block, court formatting standard. Florida family law. Built inside a real, active family law firm.

plugins.name: lal-roadmap-case-management
plugins.description: Roadmap & Case Management — Versioned case roadmap, controlled case closing with attorney-approval hard stop, branded case memo. Florida family law. Built inside a real, active family law firm.
